title: When Jackie Shroff Carries A Plant, It Is Always For A Cause | Bollywood News - News18
text: From flaunting his signature spider plant necklace and carrying saplings as gifts wherever he goes to participating in 100-tree plantation drives and urging people to plant more trees, Jackie Shroff has really become Bollywood’s in-house green warrior. It wouldn’t be wrong to call him the unofficial and self-appointed ambassador of environmental conservation in India. The actor, fondly known as “Bhidu," was once again spotted holding a potted plant at an event in Mumbai. Jackie Shroff Spotted With a Plant in an Mumbai Event A video currently circulating online shows Jackie in his signature effortless style. He wore a denim shirt with the bottom buttons left open, paired with a maroon half-coat, light blue jeans, and a denim cap. He completed the look with sunglasses and a red scarf wrapped around his neck, but it was the plant in his hand that elevated his appearance. As he made his way towards the lift, surrounded by paparazzi, photographers greeted him with, “Love you, Bhidu!" In response, Jackie smiled warmly and playfully waved the plant in acknowledgment. Jackie Shroff’s Long-Standing Commitment To The Environment Jackie Shroff has long been an advocate of promoting sustainability and environmental conservation. Over the years, he has gone beyond symbolic gestures, actively participating in plantation drives and awareness campaigns. In July last year, the actor took part in a 1,000-tree plantation drive in Lonikand village, Maharashtra. Collaborating with a clean beauty brand focused on sustainability and the Thinksharp Foundation, he helped lay the foundation for the Lonikand Biodiversity Park. Speaking at the event, he said, “This plantation drive is not just a mere initiative, but through this, we are hoping to grow love, peace, and humanity—something that cannot be destroyed today, or ever in the future. Through this, we aspire to grow something indestructible that actually works for the coming generation, so that they experience the beauty of better living, a healthier and sustainable life. True healing starts when we prioritise the well-being of people and the planet." Jackie Shroff Launches Ped Lagao Bhidu Campaign Back in 2020, Shroff also launched an online initiative through an Instagram page titled Ped Lagao Bhidu, encouraging his followers to plant more trees and care for nature. In an earlier interview with Hindustan Times, the actor expressed his deep emotional connection with plants, saying “My plants are my family, my pets. They also need shade and water. We have to nurture and take care of them. They give us oxygen, so they are your buddies. Let’s make the globe a lovely garden." “I consider myself lucky to have been given a space where I can speak about the environment, and people listen [to me]. Before becoming an actor, I worked at a travel agency and at that time, even when I said something meaningful, no one would listen. So, I’m thankful to everyone for making me what I am today, and even if a few of them listen to what I say about saving the environment and implement that, my purpose is solved," said Shroff. Apart from advocacy, Jackie Shroff also owns an organic farm where he grows plants, trees and herbs.
